data.name: Sebastian
data.gender_notes: Sebastian is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek sebastos, 'venerable', via the place name Sebaste. Its root is Greek sebastos (σεβαστός). Saint Sebastian, martyr. Sebastian is a Greek name meaning “From Sebaste; venerable”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sebastian expresses “From Sebaste; venerable”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Greek sebastos, 'venerable', via the place name Sebaste.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sebastian total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
